com.esignal.jstandard.beans.history

Interface HistoricalBarRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultHistoricalBarRequest

    public interface HistoricalBarRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to History server.

    There are two types of request that can be built for DBC (default) implementation: 1) BarCount & EndDate: Setting these values will return N number of bars for the specified period going backwards from EndDate. 2) BeginDate & EndDate: Setting these values will return all bars between Start/End dates for the specified period.

    It also includes an enum value which allows defining PERIOD of DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY while requesting the data to HistoryManager.

    Since:
    01-001-0009
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
